title: Wine Wimsey Review · Sun Nov 29
subtitle: Batch date Sun Nov 29 (ODD day): plain cards at feed slots 1,3,5,7; characters at 2,4,6. 7 feed posts + 2 stories, no captions or first comments. Characters: Homebody (#2), Hot Mess (#4 + story 2), Bold One (#6), Settled One (story 1). Seasonal: 3 of 7 feed (plain #3, characters #2 and #6) + 1 story (Christmas tree). Quotes: 1 spun (#1 from the FFF 'lied about where you were' winner; the other FFF winners were already spun or used), 0 inbox (inbox empty), 8 original. Weekday references: none, but the seasonal posts assume publish on Nov 30 or later. Credits: 5 images x 45 = 225 credits on the final run (plus 5 x 190 = 950 credits wasted on a first pass that came out 16:9 high-quality because the generate tool ignores the 4:5/low settings; fixed by setting node params and re-running). Plain cards free. Every quote matches word for word, all drawn cartoons, no stray logos. Note: recent batches (Nov 23-28) were the NEW-VOICE format (8 posts with captions, then-vs-now cards); this run followed the stored nightly prompt (7+2 plain/character, no captions). Tell me if the nightly task should switch.

posts.quote: I told my mother I was at Becky's and I'd be home by eleven. She nodded like she believed me. She'd told the same lie in 1968.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered dark text. Text reads: I told my mother I was at Becky's and I'd be home by eleven. She nodded like she believed me. She'd told the same lie in 1968.
posts.note: spun from FFF 'lied about where you were' winner

posts.quote: EVERYONE'S OUT HUNTING FOR DEALS. I FOUND MINE YEARS AGO: SWEATPANTS, A COUCH, AND NOBODY EXPECTING ME ANYWHERE.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a full-figured woman with short mauve-pink curls, a mustard knit sweater and fluffy pink slippers, reclined in a floral armchair under a blanket with a glass of red wine, a Christmas tree and a cat nearby. Text in a speech bubble at the top reads: Everyone's out hunting for deals. I found mine years ago: sweatpants, a couch, and nobody expecting me anywhere.
posts.note: seasonal (post-Thanksgiving deals season, works Nov 30 to early Dec)

posts.quote: The Christmas lights worked perfectly when I packed them in January. Nobody touched them all year. Half the strand is dead.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered dark text. Text reads: The Christmas lights worked perfectly when I packed them in January. Nobody touched them all year. Half the strand is dead.
posts.note: seasonal (Christmas decorations, works Nov 30 through Dec)

posts.quote: I RESET MY PASSWORD. THE SITE SAID MY NEW ONE CAN'T MATCH MY OLD ONE. I DON'T REMEMBER THE OLD ONE. THAT'S WHY I'M HERE.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a messy bun with a pencil in it, grey-streaked auburn hair, an olive vest and a striped shirt, squinting at a laptop showing a password box, holding a glass of red wine and a scribbled sticky note at a cluttered kitchen table. Text in a speech bubble at the top reads: I reset my password. The site said my new one can't match my old one. I don't remember the old one. That's why I'm here.

posts.quote: The printer has said 'low on ink' since 2022. It has printed everything I've asked. I think it's just guilt-tripping me.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered dark text. Text reads: The printer has said 'low on ink' since 2022. It has printed everything I've asked. I think it's just guilt-tripping me.

posts.quote: IF YOUR CHRISTMAS LETTER NEEDS A SECOND PAGE, I STOPPED READING AT YOUR DOG'S GALLBLADDER SURGERY. I HOPE HE'S WELL.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a plus-size woman with a huge copper curly halo of hair, round glasses and a bold geometric tunic, holding up a two-page letter in one hand and a glass of red wine in the other beside a decorated Christmas tree. Text in a speech bubble at the top reads: If your Christmas letter needs a second page, I stopped reading at your dog's gallbladder surgery. I hope he's well.
posts.note: seasonal (Christmas card/letter season, works Nov 30 through Dec 20)

posts.quote: My sister called to ask if I remembered the name of that restaurant. I did not. We spent forty minutes agreeing it had a red door and was somewhere in Ohio.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered dark text. Text reads: My sister called to ask if I remembered the name of that restaurant. I did not. We spent forty minutes agreeing it had a red door and was somewhere in Ohio.

stories.quote: THE CHRISTMAS TREE LEANS A LITTLE TO THE LEFT. I'VE DECIDED THAT'S ITS PERSONALITY, AND I'M NOT FIXING IT.
stories.alt: Cartoon illustration of a silver-haired woman in round lavender glasses, an oatmeal sweater and green joggers, barefoot on a couch with a mug, gazing at a decorated Christmas tree that leans to the left. Text in a speech bubble at the top reads: The Christmas tree leans a little to the left. I've decided that's its personality, and I'm not fixing it.

stories.quote: THE SMOKE DETECTOR CHIRPED ONCE AT 2 A.M., THEN STOPPED. IT'S WAITING FOR ME TO RELAX.
stories.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a messy bun with a pencil in it, grey-streaked hair, an olive vest and striped shirt, sitting up wide-eyed in a dark bedroom at 2:00 a.m. staring at a ceiling smoke detector, a glass of red wine on the nightstand. Text in a speech bubble at the top reads: The smoke detector chirped once at 2 a.m., then stopped. It's waiting for me to relax.
